text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The two largest commercial banks, VUB and IRB, said they wanted to complete restructuring of their loan portfolios using their own resources without state participation.

- The opposition Christian Democratic Movement (KDH) plans to propose another law banning privatisation of the four largest financial institutions - VUB, IRB, the largest insurer Slovenska Poistovna and the biggest savings bank Slovenska Sporitelna - at the forthcoming regular parliamentary session, starting March 18.

- Jan Luptak, leader of junior ruling coalition member, the ultra-left Workers Party (ZRS), said those ZRS deputies who helped parliament approve a law allowing privatisation of VUB and IRB made a mistake, as they misunderstood the introduction of the vote.
- Croatia is interested in purchasing unspecified Slovak-made millitary equipment.
PRAVDA - Deputy Finance Minister Peter Stanek said about 20 percent of Slovak industrial companies will have to go to bankruptcy procedures.

- The government is preparing a series of unspecified measures to reduce the widening trade deficit. Stanek said one of the ways to fight the problem can be an increase of profits from transit of gas and oil through Slovakia's territory.
- ZRS Chairman Luptak has asked the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) to allow the Highest Control Office to carry out a deep audit of the four largest financial institutions.
- KDH said it would demand the dismissal of Culture Minister Ivan Hudec and Interior Minister Gustav Krajci.
